intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of 28 zero-day exploits documented between April 12 and April 30, 2026, with 12 critical and 15 high-severity vulnerabilities identified. Threat actors APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos were observed in these campaigns, which targeted global regions and Southeast Asia. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-34621 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-3502 (CVSS 7.8), CVE-2026-32183 (CVSS 7.5), CVE-2026-32201 (CVSS 6.5), and CVE-2024-20662, affecting critical infrastructure, telecommunications, and enterprise environments.
